response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count) as avg_count_per_state FROM state_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT sc.invoice_count, sc.invoice_count / t.total_invoices as share, t.avg_count_per_state, sc.invoice_count - t.avg_count_per_state as above_average FROM state_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE sc.invoice_count > t.avg_count_per_state) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(above_average) as avg_above_average FROM with_shares
